questions.topic: PrepLadder · 16.Disorders of Adrenal Gland and Cushing Syndrome
questions.stemHtml: 16-year-old boy is brought to the ER due to fever, vomiting, and irritability for 2 days. Vitals are thready pulse 120/min, BP is 80/60 mm Hg with cold clammy extremities. General physical examination shows petechiae on extremities, CNS examination shows nuchal rigidity and kernig sign. CBC show TLC of 25000 cells/ cu.mm and platelet count of 15,000/cu.mm Gram stain of CSF is shown and rest of the lab report is awaited. Which of the following is not correct about managment of this patient? {{caption_text}}
